title.zh: 关于授权菲律宾总统将碧瑶市内某幅公有土地出售给国家发展公司的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Sell a Certain Parcel of Land of Public Domain Within the City of Baguio to the National Development Company
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Sell a Certain Parcel of Land of Public Domain Within the City of Baguio to the National Development Company

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3813_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The President of the Philippines, is hereby authorized to sell to the National Development Company, a government-owned corporation, for a nominal price of one peso, a parcel of public domain constituting the Pines Hotel site with an area of 34,762 square meters and more particularly designated as Lot 4, Plan Swo-19505, portion of Lot No. 100-New of Plan BAD-1311.

By this conveyance, the National Development Company acquires full ownership and title to said piece of land described in the preceding section: Provided, However, That the said land, subject matter of this Act, shall not be transferred, sold, mortgaged, encumbered or alienated to any person, association, or corporation without the previous authorization by the President of the Philippines.
All Acts, orders, or proclamations inconsistent with this Act are deemed repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
